text:
maria: Heads-up — audit flagged ~12 principals with admin entitlements on KMS key `prod-vault` last used >180d. Thinking we should do: 1) send 7-day rotation notice, 2) schedule credential rotation & remove stale principals, 3) run post-rotation access test. Anyone opposed?
sam: +1. Can we group by role so we don't accidentally remove service accounts? :eyes:
maria: yep — we'll use the entitlement matrix and owner tags. plan: create temp allowlist in IAM for service accounts, then prune. I'll open a ticket.
jordan: Suggest adding an event in audit logs to track removals: `events.kms.admin_prune` — need SRE to ensure export to splunk for 30d.
ashwin: I can add a dashboard and set an alert for error > 0 on removal failures. what's the runbook?
maria: draft runbook snippet:
```
- Step 1: notify owners via slack + email (7d)
- Step 2: generate rotated keys for listed principals
- Step 3: run `./scripts/validate-access --key prod-vault --principals list.txt`
- Step 4: remove principal with `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding` (or terraform)
- Step 5: monitor audit logs for `permission_denied`
```
sam: When removing, prefer terraform changes + review. manual removals are risky.
maria: Agreed. We'll create infra PR and a small canary (1 principal) then batch.
kmsaudit-bot: AUTO: Found 12 principals flagged: svc-app-a, svc-ingest, alice, bob, ci-build. Report generated: https://reports.internal/kms/1768510000
lee: Two notes — alice is on a rotation ticket expiring in 3d, leave her alone. svc-ingest is actually used by nightly job; owner tag is outdated.
maria: OK I'll update the owner matrix and exclude alice + svc-ingest for now. Action items: maria->open ticket and attach list, sam->prepare terraform module, ashwin->add dashboard+alert, jordan->ensure logs export. Deadline: rotate starting in 7 days (1769114800).
sam: I'll also add a short rollback snippet:
```
# quick rollback (apply previous state for kms module)
terraform state show module.kms && terraform apply -target=module.kms
```
maria: thanks. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll proceed. :thumbsup: 
ashwin: :thumbsup: 
jordan: :shipit: 
maria: created ticket LR-1427 and added assignees. Link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/LR-1427/kms-admin-principal-rotation
kmsaudit-bot: SCHEDULED: Rotation check will run at 1769114800 and post results.
maria: closing sync. I'll post the runbook in /docs/ops/kms-rotation
